name: How much does stucco texturing cost per square foot?

mainEntity.name: How much does stucco texturing cost per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of stucco texturing varies depending on several factors, including the complexity of the chosen texture, the condition of the existing surface, and the total square footage. More intricate textures, such as Santa Barbara, typically cost more than simpler finishes like sand float. Preparation work, such as patching or repairing existing stucco, can also influence the overall price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site evaluation to give you an accurate cost for your specific project.
